description: The 'Files touched' section (contracts/sprint-2.md:108-131) -- the SAME section rounds 6/7/8 have now fixed three times for its test-file sub-list -- contains a genuine, previously-unflagged self-contradiction and a genuine omission once the sweep is widened from 'which spawn-orchestrator.mjs test files are named' (this round's narrow assigned check, now clean -- see verdict evidence) to 'is this section, AS A WHOLE, an accurate final list of files touched this sprint' (its own stated scope at line 108: 'final list as delivered through Phase 2c (refactor)'). SELF-CONTRADICTION: line 127 states '`run.sh`, `child-spec.js`, `ledger.js`, ... are all reused UNMODIFIED (sprint-1 delivered and hardened them; this sprint calls them, never edits them...)' -- but the SAME document's own 'Round 2 additions' section, 5 lines below (line 140), states the exact opposite about the exact same file: '`~/anicca/skills/self/spawn/run.sh` MUST be rewritten (no longer reused-unmodified -- see REQ-307's own "wake-cycle scheduler's real identity" correction) to call `decideColonySpawn()` then, if eligible, `executeSpawnAttempt()`, retiring the OLD `lib/spawn-decision.js`-based gate and DO/AgentMail provisioning path'. These two sentences, in the SAME contract, directly contradict each other about whether run.sh was modified this sprint. Independently confirmed via git log this session: `git log --format='%ai %H %s' -- skills/self/spawn/run.sh` shows run.sh's most recent commit is `f3419d3` (2026-07-08 14:04:14, 'fix(self/spawn): contract-review round 2 -- ... rewrite run.sh (resolves FIND-001/002/003a/004)') -- run.sh was genuinely rewritten this sprint, not reused unmodified; the Files-touched section's own claim at line 127 is factually wrong. OMISSION: `~/anicca/skills/self/spawn/scripts/wake-gate.mjs` -- a brand-new 10.1K production file, confirmed by `git log --diff-filter=A -- skills/self/spawn/scripts/wake-gate.mjs` to be first-committed in this SAME commit f3419d3 (no prior history) -- is the file that actually implements 'run.sh's own production body calls decideColonySpawn() then executeSpawnAttempt()' (run.sh is a thin bash wrapper that `exec`s into it; confirmed by direct read of run.sh:51, `exec "$NODE" "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/wake-gate.mjs" "$@"`). This file is never named ANYWHERE in the Files-touched section (checked by `grep -n wake-gate contracts/sprint-2.md`, which returns exactly ONE hit, at line 227, an unrelated passing mention of it as 'the SAME file wake-gate.mjs reads' re: shelter-cost.jsonl -- never in the Files-touched enumeration itself). Its own dedicated test file, `lib/__tests__/wake-gate.test.mjs` (206 lines, confirmed on disk, contains the PROP-307e structural tests plus 5 behavioral tests, all currently passing), is likewise entirely absent from the Files-touched test-file list -- the SAME class of omission FIND-010/012/013 already established for spawn-orchestrator.mjs's own sibling test files, but for a DIFFERENT pair of genuinely-new files this exhaustive, non-incremental sweep (as this round's manifest explicitly required, given this is the 3rd consecutive round on this exact section) newly surfaces. Rounds 3/4/5's own verdicts already independently verified the run.sh->wake-gate.mjs->executeSpawnAttempt wiring is structurally correct at the code level (e.g. round 3 verdict: 'run.sh is now a 50-line thin wrapper that execs scripts/wake-gate.mjs, which genuinely imports and calls decideColonySpawn... then... executeSpawnAttempt') -- this finding is not about the implementation (which is fine) but about the Files-touched section's own documentation of it being wrong and incomplete.

evidence.lineRange: 108-131 (Files touched section, claims run.sh 'reused UNMODIFIED', never names scripts/wake-gate.mjs or lib/__tests__/wake-gate.test.mjs), 140-145 (Round 2 additions section, correctly states run.sh 'MUST be rewritten (no longer reused-unmodified)')

Line 140: '`~/anicca/skills/self/spawn/run.sh` MUST be rewritten (no longer reused-unmodified -- see REQ-307's own "wake-cycle scheduler's real identity" correction)'. `git log --format='%ai %H %s' -- skills/self/spawn/run.sh` top entry: '2026-07-08 14:04:14 +0900 f3419d363e59b0e2ef99a6d2652163b979825200 fix(self/spawn): contract-review round 2 -- wire REQ-304 funding gate, REQ-201 wallet validation, rewrite run.sh (resolves FIND-001/002/003a/004)'. `git log --diff-filter=A --format='%ai %H %s' -- skills/self/spawn/scripts/wake-gate.mjs` shows exactly one commit, the SAME f3419d3, with no earlier history -- confirming it is genuinely new this sprint. `grep -n 'wake-gate' contracts/sprint-2.md` -> exactly one match (line 227), never inside the Files-touched section (108-131).
evidence.testName: git log --format/--diff-filter=A on both run.sh and scripts/wake-gate.mjs (this session) + direct read of run.sh's own current body (line 51: exec into wake-gate.mjs) + grep -n 'wake-gate' contracts/sprint-2.md, cross-referenced against the Files-touched section's own text at lines 108-131 and the Round 2 additions section's text at lines 140-145
